conditional_and_speaker_findings: Both piyyutim print 'ק׳' before the first colon. They also print a second, smaller cue (ח׳) immediately before the weekday word בַּשּׁוֹפָר. The current encoding attributes the whole stanza to ק׳.

The role-change milestone and the ח׳ description must sit before <j:conditional …segment_1>, not inside either branch, so they render on a weekday, on Shabbat, or when the day is unknown. The words after the branches (אֲפַתֶּנּוּ …) stay in the ח׳ part. No source words need repeating.

The weekday and Shabbat alternates are printed as 'בַּשּׁוֹפָר (אם שבת בְּזִכְרוֹן שׁוֹפָר)'. The day decides which is said, so the paired conditionals are acceptable. The Shabbat branch is correctly type="marked", with the unpointed small rubric 'אם שבת' as the conditional's own instruction. The weekday word currently has a sheva, but the print has a patah: בַּשּׁוֹפָר.

The variant (נ״א …) follows אֲפַתֶּנּוּ in both piyyutim and is a standoff commentary note, not a choice. That is acceptable, but the anchor or targetEnd must be moved after the word, and the printed abbreviation and pointing must be preserved.
